evidence_tiers.dac_adjudicated: 20 DAC 2026 records with official presentation descriptions and evidence-cited technical fields
evidence_tiers.isca_indexed: 5 ISCA 2026 secondary-index excerpts pending primary verification
evidence_tiers.iccad_scope: ICCAD 2026 official CFP scope signals; the 2025 fallback inventory is metadata-only

rows.isca: Indexed evidence includes CODO and MLX hypotheses; primary verification pending
rows.dac: Two adjudicated records directly use LLMs or learned optimization in design flows; additional compiler/RL/DSE records connect learning to automation
rows.iccad: 2026 CFP includes AI and accelerators under system-level CAD and AI/hardware
rows.limits: DAC sample is adjudicated but small; ISCA and ICCAD entries are not comparable paper-level evidence.

rows.isca: Indexed excerpts cover structured LLM execution, MoE communication, KV-cache memory, and wafer-scale inference
rows.dac: Adjudicated records cover NPU/graph/CIM accelerators, MoE security, and LLM-generated HLS
rows.iccad: 2026 CFP includes AI/hardware and physical AI, but no 2026 paper corpus is available in this project
rows.limits: The shared LLM label spans workloads, systems, design tools, and security; it must not be treated as one technical trend.

rows.isca: ConServe excerpt centers virtual-address contiguity for KV caches; wafer-scale and MoE excerpts emphasize communication
rows.dac: CXL near-memory ANN and CIM records provide official-description evidence for memory placement and cross-level exploration
rows.iccad: 2026 CFP scope includes system efficiency, advanced integration, and 3D/chiplet design
rows.limits: No normalized cross-conference metric exists yet; memory benefits are workload- and platform-dependent.

rows.isca: Program and indexed evidence are currently sparse for this direction
rows.dac: Timing analysis, sequential characterization, DRC, thermal analysis, power-grid modeling, and package-plane synthesis are adjudicated
rows.iccad: 2026 CFP explicitly covers synthesis, placement/routing/CTS, timing, power, signal integrity, DFM, yield, reliability, and analog/RF/EM
rows.limits: ICCAD scope is not paper prevalence; DAC records are a selected adjudication batch, not the full corpus.

rows.direction: Reliability and security as design constraints
rows.isca: BusyBarn and other indexed excerpts include fault tolerance; primary verification pending
rows.dac: Adjudicated records cover NPU reliability, EM/IR integrity, and adversarial MoE offloading
rows.iccad: 2026 CFP includes security, reliability, DFM/yield, and advanced integration
rows.limits: Threat models, fault models, and guarantees differ; security and reliability must remain separate subtrees during coding.

rows.isca: Indexed evidence includes wafer-scale systems, PIM/PNM program signals, and quantum-related program titles
rows.dac: Adjudicated records include 3D-IC thermal simulation, package power-plane synthesis, CIM, and exact quantum synthesis
rows.iccad: 2026 CFP explicitly names post-CMOS, non-von Neumann, quantum, neuromorphic, bio-CAD, 3D ICs, chiplets, packaging, and physical AI
rows.limits: The evidence supports active research scope, not maturity, adoption, or commercial direction.

prohibited_inference: rising or declining direction without comparable historical snapshots
